method: Sequential fresh Qt offscreen processes. Main matrix uses ThemeManager synchronous selection, snapshot/chrome reads, current-document semantic handover, preparation, first visible layout and paint. Totals include measurement bookkeeping and intervening stages; no window dispatch, display latency or native input is measured. Cold means a fresh app process with OS file cache untouched. Initial document preparation includes first process font-metrics initialization. Detailed scopes are inclusive.
baseline_note: Same final manual probe executable on both sides; baseline keeps the exact pre-change Core/Ui DLLs. ABI is unchanged. New memory hashing is in Core, avoiding a Core-to-Ui dependency. File SHA-256 and operation-local validation sharing already exist in the baseline.

matrix_before.method: Sequential fresh offscreen processes; same immutable local CSS/font dependencies. Two return-to-theme cycles per process. Stage timings are not GUI event/display latency; detailed scopes are inclusive and cannot be summed. Images and sampled geometry/cursor hits are retained for before/after comparison. Full counter reference checked separately after timed stages.
